full_judgment: 7. Mr Md Ashraful Kamal, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners, sup-ports the Rule and submits that the plaintiff failed to prove his case and, as such, the learned Judge of the trial Court rightly dismissed the suit but the lower appellate Court without reversing the finding of facts arrived at by the trial Court most erroneously held that the former deed was executed on 11-9-1988 and later on 27-5-1989 and within this short period necessity to sell the property was not proved. He submits that plaintiff is to prove his own case but the lower appellate Court shifted the burden of proof to the defendant, which is an error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice.
